title: Add optional enum-constrained build_type to requirements schema
description: Add an optional build_type property to contracts/schemas/v1/requirements.schema.json, enum [game, cli, app, library, other]. The custom validator already enforces enum, so plan compile rejects an out-of-enum build_type while accepting requirements with no build_type. Test-first.
acceptance_criteria: requirements.schema.json declares build_type as optional, enum-constrained to [game, cli, app, library, other].
plan compile rejects a requirements.json whose build_type is outside the enum, and still accepts one with no build_type.
A test covers both the valid-omitted and invalid-value cases; full suite passes.
